entities.summary: A vast preserved colliery and coking landscape where original process routes, monumental machinery, architecture and the Ruhr Museum can fill a full day.
entities.description: Zollverein works at landscape scale. The strongest visit combines the preserved coal-processing route, monumental Shaft XII architecture, coking-plant exterior and Ruhr Museum rather than treating it as a photo stop. English-language tour scheduling requires more planning than German visits.
entities.whyWorthwhile: An unusually complete industrial environment whose scale, process legibility and architecture make it a destination rather than a specialist museum stop.
